title: Web Service
desc: Reverse proxy, redirect or serve static files by domain, optionally with authentication and WAF
moduleOffTitle: The Web service module is disabled
moduleOffDesc: While the module is disabled, all listening ports are closed. After enabling it, each listener and site takes effect according to its own switch.
empty: No listeners yet. Add one, or import a Lucky config under "Settings → Backup & Migration"
deleteListenerConfirm: Delete this listener and all of its sites?
listenIpPlaceholder: Leave empty to listen on all addresses
tlsHelp: The certificate is chosen automatically from "SSL Certificates" by domain
acceptProxyHelp: Only sources trusted in the global settings are accepted
targetsPlaceholder: http://192.168.1.10:8080; multiple backends are used round-robin
optSendProxy: Send PROXY v2 to the backend (passes the real IP; the backend must support it)
webAuth: Web auth (the browser shows a sign-in page)
usersPlaceholder: One per line as username:password (the password may be a bcrypt hash)
oauthUsersPlaceholder: One allowed identity per line as provider-key:account, e.g. github:octocat, google:me{'@'}gmail.com, qq:openid. Add a comment after # at the end of a line; github:* matches any GitHub account
providerHelp: Providers must be configured in "Global settings" first
requestHeadersPlaceholder: Sent to the backend, one Key: Value per line; an empty Value removes the header
responseHeadersPlaceholder: Returned to the client, one Key: Value per line; an empty Value removes the header
trustedPlaceholder: One IP or subnet per line; leave empty to trust no source
callbackPlaceholder: https://auth.example.com (must be served by one of Gately's listeners)
callbackHelp: The callback URL to register with GitHub / Google is: {url} (use this same URL for GitHub, Google and QQ)
savedReloaded: Saved. The listener has been reloaded
